messages:
Sam K: Quick heads-up — release cutoff is in ~6h (2026-03-18 18:00 UTC). Putting this release on the watchlist for any late merges. If you need an exception, reply here with: PR link, short justification, CI status, and who will be oncall to approve. I'll compile exceptions and triage.

Marta L: Changelog owners — can we confirm version bump? There's a docs-only PR (PR #5278) that wants a patch bump but package changes in #5290 may need minor. What's our call?

Sam K: My call: bump to 1.14.0 if there's any product-visible change; otherwise 1.13.1 for docs. If anyone disagrees speak now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Jessie P: For cherry-picks, use:
```
.git fetch origin main
git checkout -b cherry/PR-5290
git cherry-pick <commit>
git push origin cherry/PR-5290
```
Also add `release/needs-cherry-pick` label.

Cheng W: One more ask — small perf tweak in #5302 (runtime) wants a late merge. CI is green locally but flaky on macos/ci. Can we allow if ENG-SRE oncall signoff? cc @DevEx

DevEx: @Cheng W please add the failure trace and I'll loop in eng-sre. For late-runtime changes we require: unit tests coverage, flamegraph sanity, and a rollback plan. Otherwise docs-only is fine.

Release Bot: Cutoff timer set by Sam K — 2026-03-18 18:00 UTC. Current exceptions queue: 0.

Sam K: On-call rotation: Marta L will be primary for next 12h, Cheng W backup. Marta please ack.

Marta L: Ack. I'll handle exception triage and stamp merges if they meet the checklist. :white_check_mark:

Jessie P: PR #5278 - docs only - can merge under docs policy, tagging changelog owner @Sam K.

Cheng W: I'm adding CI artifacts and failure log now. If ENG-SRE gives thumbs I'll file request here.

Sam K: Thanks — I'll keep the thread updated. If no responses, we lock at cutoff and roll forward. :locked:
